questions.stem: A 6-year-old girl underwent an ultrasonography for recurring abdominal pain. The scan revealed a horse-shoe kidney without any other abnormalities. The stool examination revealed Giardia. The girl was given Anti-Giardial medication and she responded to the treatment. Which statement regarding her horse-shoe kidney is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The most common fusion is at the upper pole.

options.label: B
options.text: Urgent CT urography with angiography to ascertain the vascularity at the fusion to aid in the separation of both the kidneys

options.label: C
options.text: No treatment needed for horse-shoe kidney

options.label: D
options.text: Diagnostic laparoscopy is key in the further treatment of the girl
